summary: Validated new GET /api/admin/tutor/feedback-stats endpoint with 7 pytest cases (100% pass). All required scenarios covered: happy path (upTotal=4/downTotal=2/satisfactionPct=67/scope=course/topNegative+topPositive populated/recent sorted desc), empty project (zeros + nulls, no crash), cross-project isolation, auth-required (401/403 without token), cleared-null rating exclusion, topNegative ordering (-down then -up). Frontend UI (TutorDashboard feedback panel) could NOT be exercised end-to-end via Playwright because the /data/db disk partition (10GB shared with /root and /app) reached 100% during the session causing MongoDB to crash and browser-automation ENOSPC. After freeing diagnostic data MongoDB came back online (verified via curl /api/auth/login = 200). Source-code review of TutorDashboard.jsx confirms all required data-testids are wired: tutor-feedback-panel, feedback-empty-state, feedback-stats-loaded, kpi-thumbs-up/down/satisfaction, satisfaction-bar-positive/negative, top-negative-list, top-positive-list, back-to-dashboard. setFeedbackStats(null) is invoked in the back-button onClick handler (line 89).
action_items: INFRA: /dev/nvme0n6 (10GB partition serving /root, /app and /data/db) reached 100%. MongoDB crashed mid-test. Operator should grow this volume; testing agent pruned /data/db/diagnostic.data to recover but headroom is fragile. Not a code bug.

Once disk is resolved, main agent can self-verify UI: (a) seed 3-5 POST /api/tutor/feedback rows for a real projectId with tutor_logs entries, (b) /admin -> 'Dashboard Tutor' tab -> click the course, (c) confirm tutor-feedback-panel renders with non-zero KPIs and 'Voltar' clears state.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py:611 — Endpoint correct and read-only. Pulling docs (cap 5000) + Python aggregation is fine for current per-course volume; if a course ever exceeds 5000 ratings, switch to Mongo $group + $facet pipeline.
admin.py:633 — Super_admin without projectId returns scope='all' which scans whole collection up to 5000 docs; consider requiring projectId or paginating for very large deployments.
TutorDashboard.jsx:65 — fetchFeedbackStats nulls feedbackStats at start (correct anti-stale). Rapid double-click race is harmless (panel briefly shows spinner).

success_rate.frontend: code-review only — blocked by disk-full env

seed_data_creation: Autouse fixture deletes tutor_feedback docs where sessionId starts with 'ftest-' before+after each test. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend GET /api/admin/tutor/feedback-stats fully validated (7/7 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_tutor_feedback_stats.py). UI panel not exercised due to /data/db ENOSPC; once disk freed, navigate /admin -> Tutor Dashboard -> click a course to verify panel.
rca of the issue: MongoDB crashed because /dev/nvme0n6 (10GB shared by /root, /app, /data/db) hit 100% disk usage. Symptom: backend returned 500 'localhost:27017 Connection refused' on /api/auth/login. Fix: stopped mongo, pruned /data/db/diagnostic.data + /root/.emergent/automation_output, restarted mongo - login works again (200 OK). Underlying volume is undersized; ops should expand. Backend feature itself is provably correct.
